_comment: Claude model-tier -> per-harness model id, used when porting agents/*.md frontmatter `model:` to a harness that does not share Claude's model names (lib/targets/codex.js agents/*.toml generation, lib/targets/omp-agents.js agents/*.md generation). Best-known defaults as of 2026-08 — doctor should validate these against the harness's own model listing (for Codex: ~/.codex/models_cache.json) and flag drift rather than trust this file blindly.

omp._comment: omp model ids are '<provider>/<model-id>' (spike S4-S5). haiku/sonnet/opus feed agents/*.md frontmatter `model:` the same way as the codex map above; review/scout are omp modelRoles (config.yml modelRoles.<role>) with no Claude-tier equivalent — review defaults to sonnet (personal CLAUDE.md: 'delegate to subagents (default sonnet)'), scout to haiku (cheap/fast lookups). Not omp-native role names (verified absent from the config.yml schema and BUNDLED_AGENTS in the 18.0.4 binary strings dump) — a local convention this dotfiles setup defines for its own agents to reference.

deepseek._comment: DeepSeek cloud tiers (2026-09 current docs). flash = cheap/fast main tier; pro = higher capability. Reasoning is a MODE (reasoning_effort), not a separate model id, so there is no reasoner tier. These are the ids passed to the deepseek backend's OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions.

local._comment: Local OpenAI-compatible server tiers (LM Studio). qwen = Qwen3.8-27B, the deterministic/offline tier. Model id must match what LM Studio has loaded; override per machine with YOKI_LOCAL_MODEL.
